method: Separate compiled QA identifier and empty app data. Only .env loopback service endpoints and 8192/2048 QA request limits were preconfigured; database, AI preferences, setup dismissal and credentials were not preseeded. No production app data or Keychain namespace used.

first_launch.note: Measurements are the setup snapshot, not an inference benchmark.

model_selection.alias_note: Explicit QA alias of identical 0.8b weights. This validates preference switching, not a second model quality comparison.

failed.condition: Only owned Ollama server HTTPS_PROXY pointed to closed 127.0.0.1:9; localhost model inventory still worked.
failed.error: Download did not finish. Check Ollama, storage and connection, then retry. Use Download model to retry.

explicit_retry.note: The real model was already cached in the isolated store from earlier actual download. This retry confirms registry/installation, not another full weight transfer.

cancel.action: Clicked Cancel download while actual bytes arrived
cancel.notice: Noye's download request cancelled. Ollama may retain partial files for retry.

quit.action: Explicitly restarted the same 2b pull and quit the app while UI said downloading

credential_scope: Separate synthetic Keychain cross-process check passed and removed its QA item. This native pass entered no real or fake provider key; actual protected provider credential entry, authorization and cloud billing remain untested.
distribution: No valid Developer ID signing identity was available. A linker-only ad-hoc bundle initially failed strict bundle verification (no resource envelope). Only this QA bundle received a local ad-hoc envelope and then passed codesign --verify --deep --strict. No Gatekeeper setting was changed; no notarization or trusted distribution is claimed.
tool_latency: The first CUA path-based app selection took 201.31 seconds before returning an empty window; it is not an isolated app startup measurement. Later identifier-based selections returned startup UI in 1.45/1.86 seconds. No screen-status question was sent to the user.
